offering_description.value: Coca-Cola Consolidated bottles and distributes nonalcoholic beverages for grocery stores, convenience stores, restaurants and other foodservice operators. It supplies packaged drinks and fountain syrup through its regional distribution network and provides freight and logistics services to businesses.

primary_products.value: carbonated soft drinks; bottled water; sports and energy drinks; ready-to-drink teas and juices; fountain beverage syrups

primary_services.value: truck freight transportation; freight brokerage; fleet maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: Grocery chains, mass merchandisers, convenience stores, restaurants, vending operators and commercial shippers

end_markets.value: grocery and mass-market retail; convenience retail; restaurants and institutional foodservice; vending; commercial freight

revenue_model.value: product sales: Packaged beverages and fountain syrups sold to retailers and foodservice operators; service fees: Freight hauling, shipment arrangement and fleet maintenance for commercial customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Uses beverage concentrates, sweeteners and packaging to produce finished drinks for retail and foodservice customers; distributor: Supplies beverages from its own plants and other producers to retailers and foodservice operators; service provider: Uses company trucks and third-party carriers to move freight for commercial shippers

geography_served.value: US regional: Beverage territories across the Southeast, Mid-Atlantic and Midwest, including Washington, D.C.

specialization.value: related lines: Packaged soft drinks and other nonalcoholic beverages, fountain syrups, and transportation and logistics services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct store delivery and warehouse delivery for retail and foodservice accounts, plus direct sales to freight customers; third-party retail: Grocery stores, mass merchandisers and convenience stores sell packaged drinks to consumers; other: Restaurants and vending operators sell fountain or packaged drinks to consumers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food safety and labeling rules for beverages and federal motor carrier safety rules for trucking

notes: The current scope of fleet maintenance services for external customers is uncertain.
